milestone_description: Phani Gogireddy begins cinematography learning and on-set camera work during actor Manchu Manoj's feature film Mr. Nookayya (song 'Oke Oka Jeevitham').
notes: Foundational mentorship connection with actor Manchu Manoj.

milestone_description: Phani Gogireddy launches 24 Frames Photography as a boutique fine-art wedding photography and cinematography studio in Hyderabad.
notes: WMG profile indicates active tenure since ~2015; earliest independent client records date to 2013-2014.

milestone_description: 24 Frames YouTube channel publishes its earliest preserved engagement film: 'Best Engagement Teaser of Anudeep & Kaumudi' (video ID DIZ_-WPxxtI).
notes: Earliest verified video publication on the official channel.

milestone_description: Official brand domain 24framesphotography.com registered with GoDaddy (active through 2027-09-20).
notes: WHOIS database verification from Verisign registry.

milestone_description: Production and release of 'Divya & Federico 2019: Cross-Cultural Wedding Celebration', expanding portfolio into international diaspora clientele.
Coverage of Sree Vidyanikethan International School Annual Day 2020 featuring legendary actor Manchu Mohan Babu and Manchu Manoj.

milestone_title: Viral Multi-Event Wedding: Anoop X Rithika
milestone_description: Release of 'Anoop X Rithika: A Beautiful Wedding Story', gaining over 18,000 views and establishing signature sangeet and wedding film pacing.
notes: Core portfolio anchor for prospective couples.

milestone_description: Nikon India officially announces Phani Gogireddy as an official Nikon Influencer and partner, acknowledging his authority across AP and Telangana.
notes: Critical manufacturer credential and camera brand association.

milestone_description: Prominent Telugu actress and anchor Syamala releases an official on-camera endorsement praising 24 Frames' cinematic excellence and emotional authenticity.

milestone_title: Breakthrough Viral Film: Manoj X Snigdha (173k Views)
milestone_description: Manoj X Snigdha wedding film reaches 173,000 views on YouTube, establishing 24 Frames as a viral high-production Telugu wedding filmmaker.
notes: Top-viewed private wedding film on the channel.

milestone_title: 6000 Sq Ft Corporate Office Inauguration & Alankara Decor Launch
milestone_description: Tollywood actor Manchu Manoj officially cuts the ribbon for 24 Frames' 6,000 sq ft corporate office and launches sister company Alankara Event Decor.
notes: Major physical infrastructure expansion and diversification into turnkey event decor.

milestone_title: ET Excellence Award 2025 by The Times of India
milestone_description: Conferred with 'Excellence in Luxury Wedding Photography' by Times of India / ET Now at Novotel HICC Hyderabad, presented by Dia Mirza.

milestone_title: World Jr #1 Badminton Player Siril Verma Event
milestone_description: Release of the Thambhulam event film for international badminton champion Siril Verma and Devi Poojitha in Hyderabad.

milestone_title: Deployment of Nikon ZR Cinema Line with RED Color Science
milestone_description: Studio announces massive equipment upgrade with Nikon ZR cinema cameras powered by RED digital color science.
notes: Technical cinematography upgrade to cinema-grade sensors.

milestone_title: Bellamkonda Sai Sreenivas & Kavya Reddy Grand Reception Film
milestone_description: Release of the ultra-luxury wedding reception film for hero Bellamkonda Sai Sreenivas (193k views), featuring Megastar Chiranjeevi and Kajal Aggarwal.
notes: Crown jewel celebrity wedding project in modern Telugu cinema circle.

milestone_title: RFAC Inauguration & Masterclass with K.K. Senthil Kumar Garu
milestone_description: Phani Gogireddy invited as an honored guest and industry speaker at Raw Fine Arts College inauguration alongside legendary cinematographer K.K. Senthil Kumar.
notes: Recognition as an industry educator and master practitioner.
